reference.title: NC State Gmail Access and Support
reference.shortdesc: Find information about access to your NC State Gmail account, including supported email applications and account availability.

refbody.refsyn: NC State uses Gmail as its email provider for students, faculty, and staff. The NC State Help Desk only supports logging into gmail.com and official Gmail apps.

ul.li: Web browsers: Users can access their NC State email through Gmail using their university-issued Google account.
Android: Users can use the official Gmail app to access their NC State email on an Android device.
iPhone or iPad: Users can use the official Gmail app to access their NC State email on an Apple device.

Third-party applications: Users may use alternative applications to access their NC State Gmail account. However, the NC State Help Desk does not support troubleshooting or configuration of alternative applications.

section.title: Information for Incoming Students
section.p: New incoming students will not have an NC State Google account created until after they have confirmed their enrollment and have paid the Advanced Enrollment Deposit. After both of those are completed, they will need to wait 2-3 days for their email account to be created.
